capabilities: Extract collocates within a ±N token sliding window
Render frequent collocates as a rotating 3D word sphere
Open KWIC concordance views and jump to source notes
Filter analysis by note modification date
disambiguation: Not a text search tool; it computes statistical word co-occurrence and renders it as an interactive 3D sphere with concordance views.
extras: Not available on mobile. Installation is manual (clone the repo into .obsidian/plugins/). README is bilingual in English and Chinese; author recommends disabling default stopword lists for small vaults. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This program is forked from liyaoming.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to surface implicit, habitual lexical co-occurrence patterns across a vault's text.

relations.evidence: This program is forked from liyaoming.

summary: Corpus-linguistics plugin that extracts habitual word collocations from the vault and displays them in a 3D word sphere with KWIC concordance views.
